outcome.final_sql:
WITH top_customer_info AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Currency,
        SUM(t.Price) AS total_spent,
        SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item
    FROM customers c
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency
    ORDER BY total_spent DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    CustomerID AS top_spending_customer,
    avg_price_per_item AS average_price_per_single_item,
    Currency AS currency_used
FROM top_customer_info;
